text: Epigenetic restoration of NHE6 with HDAC inhibitors normalized the ApoE4-specific endosomal pH defect, supporting NHE6 loss as the mediator of APOE4-driven hyperacidification.
description: ApoE4 astrocytes treated with histone deacetylase inhibitors (agents, doses and duration not specified); species and source not specified. Abstract-only. Caveat: a pharmacological rescue with HDAC inhibitors, which act broadly beyond NHE6.

provenance.excerpt: Epigenetic restoration of NHE6 expression with histone deacetylase inhibitors normalized ApoE4-specific defects in endosomal pH, LRP1 trafficking and amyloid clearance.

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE4 + HDAC inhibitor -> restored NHE6) -> (normalized endosomal pH, reversal of APOE4 hyperacidification)

perturbed.variable: histone deacetylase inhibitor treatment restoring NHE6 expression in ApoE4 astrocytes (reversal of the APOE4 effect)
